motions.label: Programmed fall recovery · wheel braking
motions.description: A simulated forward-left fall, then a fold onto the back, gyro-based wheel braking during leg return, back get-up and learned balance. This example passes both timesteps. The fixed controller passes 9/9 fresh starts at both timesteps.
motions.limit_text: 10/10 prior near-floor failures now pass both timesteps; 18/18 fresh rollouts pass; 8/8 standing-release directions pass both timesteps. The full 24-second native record starts from standing with a prescribed tipping velocity, then uses continuous dynamics without state correction. The get-up is programmed; balance is learned. Four motors and 120 mm wheels are unchanged. These finite tests do not qualify all falls, hardware uncertainty, internal self-contact, printed strength or sim2real.
